summary:
## Idea
A pure ownership reducer selects work by priority band and per-band order, with explicit pre-emption, suspension, resumption, cancellation and queue refusal decisions.

## Complexity
State work grows with the admitted waiting/suspended population; list-based selection and updates can scan it. Budget the waiting limit explicitly; no constant-time scheduling claim is made.

## Use when
One logical resource has competing owners and pre-emption must be explainable/replayable.

## Avoid when
Parallel ownership is permitted or the application needs a distributed lease service.

## Pitfalls
Policies decide cancellation permissions and takeover ordering. A returned decision is data; execute and prove effects separately. A suspended entry is not completed.

## F# usage
Package: FS.GG.Algorithms; cited source API (resolve your actual package pin).


## Tests
ArbitrationTests: invariant sequences, 300-run no-starvation drain, pre-emption chain, band ordering, duplicate/unknown/queue-full refusals.

## Bench
Owed: technique-specific timing baseline under https://github.com/FS-GG/FS.GG.Algorithms/issues/1. No timing or cross-runtime performance claim is made here.
